kind.description: llm: a worker, a headless harness CLI the supervisor launches for one role (model-work.adoc, Supervision & Recycling). probe: a program found on the machine or in a checkout and not enrolled yet, run after the operator's consent (job-runtime.adoc, Probe Jobs); its scope is machine or entry. A review-bot poll is a ci job (budget key ci:<operation>), never a kind of its own.

execution.description: in_process only for git and ci operations of the native variant; their process fields (argv_digest, pid, process_started_at, spawned_at, exit_code, signal) are null and confinement is not_applicable.

type.description: project: a worker, which serves the project's task queue rather than one scope; machine: a job or worker of the machine scope (its probes, the steward); entry: a probe job of a project's onboarding before its enrolment.

id.description: The plan_id, epic_id, or entry_id; null for the workspace scope, for a worker of a project, and for the machine scope.

worker.description: Required (non-null) iff kind == llm: the launch contract, the job-bound connection, and the protocol state of a worker; null for every other kind.

role.description: The role the worker serves (identifiers.adoc, role name).

configuration_digest.description: The configuration digest (model-work/01, Role Artifact Schema) over the role's effective values the worker was launched with (artifact, assignments); the generation is offered tasks only while this is the role's current configuration digest, and a change applies to the next generation (PM-WF-14).

class.description: The role's class: its PM-MCP and harness tool sets (model-work.adoc, Roles & Configuration); a writer worker works in one plan's worktree, at most one per plan at a time.

form.description: fresh: one task, then the job ends; warm: tasks until the supervisor recycles or ends it.

harness.description: harness_id of the harness of the role's effective configuration (an enrolled harness with a headless template, Harness Enrolment Store, an operator-added one included); its harness profile marks it worker-eligible and serves the worker's connection.

harness_version.description: Version probed at spawn; within the profile's supported version range of the enrolled harness (Harness Enrolment Store).

model.description: Model passed to the harness, the role's effective model (model-work/01, Role Assignment).

effort.description: Effort passed after narrowing to the nearest value the harness and model support; null when none was passed.

effort_narrowed_from.description: The role's effective effort when it was narrowed; null otherwise.

generation_id.description: The worker's generation, equal to its job_id (identifiers.adoc, generation_id); carried by its relay.

workdir.description: The working directory fixed at launch; a warm worker serves only tasks that run there (model-work.adoc, Supervisor).

kind.description: job_private: the empty cwd/ of a zero_tool worker (the screener, the judge) and of a graded worker whose qualification item carries its corpus context in-band.

plan_id.description: plan_worktree only: the plan; null otherwise.

prompt_digest.description: SHA-256 of the server-composed launch prompt (model-work.adoc, Worker Launch).

job_token_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the 256-bit job token the relay sends as PM-MCP-Job-Token; the token itself is never stored. Valid only while status == running; null for a zero_tool worker (the screener, the judge), which gets no connection.

connected_at.description: First call of the worker's connection; null while it never called (a worker that exits before its first call is a start failure).

state.description: Worker state of the task protocol (model-work.adoc, Task Protocol), written at every protocol transition (offer, acknowledgement, consultation, submit, end); waiting before the first offer and after a submit.

task.description: The queue task leased to this generation; null while the worker holds none.

served_tasks.description: The queue tasks this generation closed, in order; a token budget recycles a warm worker only after at least one.

worktree_mark.description: The working directory's state when this warm generation closed its latest task: the next offer to it carries the paths changed since (model-work/02, Changed since the Last Task); null for a fresh worker and before the first close.

idle_wakeups.description: Consecutive bounded waits that ended without a task; reset by an offer.

context_tokens.description: The context size of the worker's last turn, from the harness's per-turn usage; compared with the role's token budget. Never taken from a run total.

delivered_skills.description: Delivery record: the skills this generation has received, in-band in its launch prompt, with an offer, or loaded through pm_skill; an offer carries only the required skills not listed here (PM-SKILL-4), and a submit is refused skills_not_loaded while a required skill of its task is missing here (model-work.adoc, Skill Delivery Record).

end_reason.description: Why the worker ended (model-work.adoc, Supervision & Recycling): an instructed end (task_done of a fresh worker, withdrawn of a fresh worker whose leased task was withdrawn, a recycle, idle_yield, drain), a detection signal (exited, ack_missed, silence; the worker is lost), the budget, or a start failure; null while it runs.

start_failure.description: true when the worker exited before its first call, or was ended at its start because it loaded more than its launch (model-work.adoc, Loaded at Start); counted toward the role's start-failure guard, never as a lost worker.

harness_error.description: The harness's own error text of a start failure (the last lines of its output, at most 2 KiB, redacted; for example an account usage limit), or, for a worker ended because it loaded more than its launch, the names of the plugins, MCP servers, and tools the worker loaded beyond its launch; reported to the operator, never to a model.

budget_key.description: Budget key of the job (identifiers.adoc, budget key).

kind.description: A project_script job records operator (its enrolled max_timeout_seconds). The budget of every job starts at spawn; queued time is outside it.

argv_digest.description: SHA-256 of the verified argument vector; null for an in_process operation.

status.description: queued: waiting for a build slot or, for a worker, a model slot; not spawned, budget not started; queued and running are never fates.

fate.description: null iff status is queued or running.

pid.description: Job PID, equal to its process-group id, set by the mandatory post-spawn replace; null in the write-ahead record, for a refused job, and for an in_process operation. A running record with pid null after a restart is killed as an unidentifiable orphan.

process_started_at.description: OS process start instant, set with pid by the post-spawn replace; with pid the liveness identity.

confinement.description: Taken from the launch report of pm-exec (job-runtime.adoc, Launch report). partial(container_engine) replaces confined for every process job of a project whose enrolment opts into the container engine: the ruleset is applied, and the container daemon the job can reach writes outside it (job-runtime.adoc, Container Engine). seatbelt is the macOS sandbox profile of the launcher (job-runtime.adoc, macOS Confinement).

child_wall_ms.description: Wall time of the job's child process, from its OS process start (process_started_at) to its observed exit, in milliseconds; null for an in_process operation, a refused job, and while queued or running. With the job's wall time (spawned_at to ended_at; queued time is outside both) the source of the PM-MIG-5 build-overhead trigger (phase-workflows.adoc, Migration Trigger Evaluation).

landlock_abi.description: Landlock ABI version of the ruleset applied to the job (Linux, confinement confined or partial(container_engine)); null when no ruleset was applied (partial(abi=1), seatbelt, unavailable, not_applicable).

outcome_row.description: Row of the closed outcome derivation table (job-runtime.adoc#outcome-derivation) that decided the fate; null iff status is queued or running.

refusal_reason.description: The refusal reason (for example enrolment_tampered, build_config_changed, path_traversal_rejected, harness_not_enrolled, harness_update_unverified, harness_version_unsupported); non-null iff fate == refused.

cancel_before_group.description: true when a termination signal met ESRCH before the launcher called setpgid and was sent to the PID directly (job-runtime.adoc Process Termination, step 4).

self_report_contradiction.description: project_script only: the contradiction of outcome row 6 between the job's self-reported status and the observed evidence; null otherwise.

parse_result.description: The parser's verdict on the job log.

clamped_values.description: Every configured value used by this job that lay outside its floor or cap and was clamped (timeouts.adoc#configuration-keys); empty when none was clamped. Never rendered in the job facts.

configured.description: null when the source is unreadable.

gate_facts.description: Server-derived gate coverage facts of a build job whose result is a gate result (job-runtime.adoc Gate Honesty Verification, item 2); null for every other job. Only gate_coverage, degraded, and uncovered are rendered.

empty_scope.description: Dimensions attempted over an empty scope; neither a pass nor a gap.

skipped_tests.description: Tests that skipped themselves at run time in a module of the realized footprint (job-runtime.adoc Gate Honesty Verification, item 3); recorded only, never rendered, never a degradation.

reason.description: The skip reason the parser reads; null where the log gives none.

side_state.description: Ignored paths of the plan's worktree outside the compiled artifact pattern table and .marshall/** at a whole-tree gate (job-runtime.adoc Gate Honesty Verification, item 5); recorded only, never rendered, never a degradation. Empty paths and total 0 for a module gate.

structural_limits.description: Per checked analysis kind its registered limit, or UNKNOWN when none is registered; never omitted.

uncovered.description: not_at_this_scope and not_by_this_gate for a declared scope; undeclared without one, never an empty list.
